intro.fr: MetroCUBEvania se joue en multiworld Archipelago grâce à un APWorld communautaire, distribué hors de l'installation officielle.
intro.en: MetroCUBEvania can be played in an Archipelago multiworld through a community APWorld, distributed outside the official install.

text.fr: Création du dépôt GitHub ap-metrocubevania/ap-metrocubevania, qui héberge l'APWorld de MetroCUBEvania.
text.en: The GitHub repository ap-metrocubevania/ap-metrocubevania, home of the MetroCUBEvania APWorld, is created.

text.fr: Publication de la première version, v_0.0.1.
text.en: The first version, v_0.0.1, is released.

text.fr: Publication de la version v_0.2.0, la plus récente au 21 octobre 2026 (13 versions publiées).
text.en: Version v_0.2.0 is released, the latest as of October 21, 2026 (13 versions released).

text.fr: MetroCUBEvania figure dans le tableur communautaire des APWorlds, qui recense les mondes jouables hors de l'installation officielle d'Archipelago.
text.en: MetroCUBEvania is listed in the community APWorlds spreadsheet, which tracks the worlds playable outside the official Archipelago install.
